title: 活字内测开始：给 Agent 时代造一张稳定的桌子
excerpt: Agents 一月一换，Skills 每周更新，但人和组织真正在乎的目标、数据、知识结构是缓慢的。我们把 Claude Code 本地文件的工作方式搬到了云端——一个面向 Agent 的云端文本系统，今天进入内测。
titleSecondary: Huozi Beta Kickoff — A Stable Desk for the Agent Era
excerptSecondary: Agents change monthly. Skills iterate weekly. But the goals, data, and knowledge structures that humans and teams actually care about move slowly. So we took Claude Code's local file workflow and moved it to the cloud. Today huozi enters beta.
